# Fetcher

> Typed HTTP clients, streaming, React hooks, and data viewers.

## Start

- [Start with Fetcher](/start/) — Choose the shortest path from the core Fetch client to the Fetcher package you need.
- [Installation](/start/installation) — Install Fetcher packages with the required runtime and peer dependencies.
- [First Request](/start/first-request) — Install Fetcher and make a typed HTTP request in five minutes.
- [Choose Packages](/start/choose-packages) — Match each Fetcher package to the developer job it performs.

## Learn

- [Request Lifecycle](/learn/request-lifecycle) — Follow a Fetcher request through exchange creation, interceptors, native fetch, error handling, and result extraction.
- [URLs, Bodies, and Results](/learn/requests-and-results) — Build Fetcher URLs and request bodies, then choose the result shape your application needs.
- [Interceptors, Errors, and Timeouts](/learn/interceptors-errors-timeouts) — Extend the Fetcher pipeline and diagnose status, network, cancellation, and timeout failures.
- [Streaming](/learn/streaming) — Parse Server-Sent Events, convert JSON events, stop on a terminator, and cancel safely.
- [React Data Flow](/learn/react-data-flow) — Model asynchronous work as explicit React loading, result, error, cancellation, and query state.

## Recipes

- [Declarative API Services](/recipes/declarative-services) — Turn TypeScript decorator metadata into executable Fetcher service methods.
- [Generate an OpenAPI Client](/recipes/openapi-client) — Generate Fetcher TypeScript models and clients from a local or remote OpenAPI document.
- [Stream an OpenAI Response](/recipes/openai-streaming) — Configure ChatClient for typed non-streaming and streaming Chat Completions responses.
- [Build a Wow CQRS Client](/recipes/wow-cqrs) — Send Wow commands and query materialized snapshots with typed filters, pagination, streaming, and aggregation.
- [Add CoSec Authentication](/recipes/cosec-authentication) — Add CoSec request headers, token storage, automatic refresh, and authorization error handling to a Fetcher.
- [Share State and Events](/recipes/state-and-events) — Store typed values and coordinate serial, parallel, and cross-tab work with Fetcher packages.
- [Build a Data Viewer](/recipes/data-viewer) — Compose field definitions, filters, columns, views, data loading, and remote definitions into a Viewer workflow.

## Skills

- [Fetcher Skills](/skills/) — Use Fetcher package-aware skills with Codex and other compatible coding agents.
- [HTTP and service skills](/skills/http-and-services) — Choose Fetcher skills for direct requests, declarative services, typed events, and storage.
- [Streaming and OpenAI skills](/skills/streaming-and-openai) — Choose Fetcher skills for Server-Sent Events and OpenAI chat streaming.
- [OpenAPI and generation skills](/skills/openapi-and-generation) — Choose Fetcher skills for OpenAPI TypeScript types and generated clients.
- [React and integration skills](/skills/react-and-integrations) — Choose Fetcher skills for React state, data viewers, CoSec authentication, and Wow CQRS.

## Reference

- [Package reference](/reference/) — Choose the Fetcher package that owns a responsibility, then use the right depth of documentation.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher`](/reference/fetcher) — Configure Fetcher, send typed HTTP requests, and diagnose lifecycle failures.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher-decorator`](/reference/decorator) — Define declarative Fetcher services and understand metadata, execution, and inheritance.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher-eventbus`](/reference/eventbus) — Select typed in-process or cross-tab event delivery and own its lifecycle.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher-eventstream`](/reference/eventstream) — Convert SSE responses into typed Web Streams and own parsing and cancellation boundaries.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher-storage`](/reference/storage) — Persist one typed key, choose serialization and runtime storage, and own local change listeners.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher-react`](/reference/react) — Own Fetcher, query, storage, event, security, and Wow state in React.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher-openapi`](/reference/openapi) — Type OpenAPI 3.x documents, references, extensions, and schemas without runtime code.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher-generator`](/reference/generator) — Generate TypeScript models and Fetcher or Wow clients from an OpenAPI JSON or YAML document.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher-openai`](/reference/openai) — Call OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions through Fetcher, including typed SSE, cancellation, and protocol failures.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher-wow`](/reference/wow) — Complete reference for Wow commands, typed snapshot and event queries, filters, cursors, aggregation, and state loading.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher-cosec`](/reference/cosec) — Configure CoSec request attribution, JWT storage and refresh, retry limits, cleanup, and security boundaries.
- [`@ahoo-wang/fetcher-viewer`](/reference/viewer) — Compose typed filters, tables, saved views, and Fetcher-backed Viewer flows.

## Contributing

- [Contributing](/contributing/) — Set up Fetcher locally and choose the right development, testing, or documentation workflow.
- [Development](/contributing/development) — Install the Fetcher monorepo, understand package boundaries, and follow its TypeScript workflow.
- [Testing](/contributing/testing) — Run the right Fetcher unit, integration, browser, Wiki, and Storybook checks.
- [Documentation](/contributing/documentation) — Keep Fetcher Wiki, README, examples, diagrams, and package skills accurate and bilingual.
